methodology.enumeration: Every familiar seven-distinct-letter mask and all seven centers; exact accepted lists independently matched against the raw ENABLE dictionary for every mask.
methodology.benchmark: Sum of at most ten highest-scoring words, points descending then ASCII word ascending. Boards with fewer than ten are explicitly flagged; all current default-qualified boards have ten.
methodology.points: Four letters = 1; otherwise length; all seven distinct letters adds 7.
methodology.longWordDefinition: At least eight letters; per-board complete length histograms and maximum lengths are also supplied.
methodology.percentile: Nearest lower order statistic: sorted[floor((n-1)*p)]. Ratios are unrounded in threshold comparisons.
methodology.familiarity: Pinned original AI editorial shortlist only. Zero human reviews; no empirical frequency evidence. No inferred frequency ratings.
methodology.activation: Audit only; no quality threshold activated.
